title: Initials: four more copies outside the people cell still draw punctuation for names like "Alice (Sales)" (kanban owner, history timeline, user menu, presence stack)
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oY5WCqqqBMtn9qt7m

## What happens

A user whose display name contains a bracket or other punctuation (e.g. `Alice (Sales)`) gets initials such as `A(` on four faces. PR #36324 (#36046) fixes the people cell and the avatar widget by moving them onto `@object-ui/fields` `getPersonInitials` (letters only). Four naive copies remain (read from source on that PR's branch; not driven in a browser):

- `ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanCardOwner.ts` `ownerInitials` (kanban card owner)
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/HistoryTimeline.tsx` `initialsFromName` (history timeline)
- `ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts` `getUserInitials` (user menu)
- `ui/packages/collaboration/src/PresenceAvatars.tsx` (presence stack)

## Done when

- Each face draws letters-only initials by the same rule as `getPersonInitials`: call it where the package may depend on `@object-ui/fields`; where it may not, say which shared home the rule moves to (one rule, not a fifth copy).
- One family pin across the faces with an `Alice (Sales)` name, with an ablation.

Blocked by nothing; best picked up after PR #36324 lands (it is where `getPersonInitials` becomes letters-only).
